name: Jev
description: One TypeSafe API key shared by every Jev capability in PipiCOC.

ext.jev.apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
ext.jev.apiKey.description: Stored in the app vault and shared by all Jev features. Existing sessions refresh at their next idle restart boundary.

ext.jev.preselectEnabled.title: Enable Jev context preselection
ext.jev.preselectEnabled.description: Supply selected private context before Keeper requests. Requires a configured TypeSafe API key.

ext.jev.preselectAllowanceMs.title: Jev preselection time budget (ms)
ext.jev.preselectAllowanceMs.description: Optional preparation time per player input, shared by locating, reading and checking material. It adds to the player's wait and is recorded in telemetry.
